built_by: KNOCKOUT-BATCH-2 LANE-11 subagent (capacity-vs-prevalence competing ecological predictors; the v10 pairing-4 gap: 'NO retrieved study directly pits CAPACITY against PREVALENCE as competing ecological predictors of violent crime/homicide in one design' — this build runs that design on the banked pulls)
laws: capacities bucketed at the source's own legend breaks (no invented thresholds)
reverse-causation guard: capacity AND prevalence may both co-move with need (money-follows-crisis class) — flagged per arm
format-lock: Mann-Whitney U where the anchor designs use it; Spearman for ordinal-bucket ecologies

anchor.gap_claim: The CAPACITY side is deeply VERIFIED (Penrose canon: Grecco 2019; Wild 2022; Rajkumar 2022; Mundt; Allison 2018) plus one counter-anchor (Salisbury & Thornicroft 2016). The PREVALENCE side is thin/indirect (Li 2026; Taiwan 2026; Korea 2025; Australia 2026). NO study pits capacity against prevalence in one ecological design.
anchor.design_here: 50-state cross-section: NRI Fig-4 state-hospital residents per 100k (4 legend buckets: 2-7.4 / 7.4-10.0 / 10-15.2 / 15.2-29) x CDC Mapping-IOV state rates (fpsi-y8tj TTM + 2024) x CDC BRFSS prevalence (5eh7-pjx8, depressive-disorder %, poor-MH-days, social isolation) — all three on the SAME state grain in one design

capacity_side.source: NRI 2025 State Profiles, 'Use of State Psychiatric Hospitals, 2025' (July 2025), Figure 4 (URS 2023, first day of state FY2023 residents per 100k)
capacity_side.extraction: vector-choropleth fill-classification (71 paths, 4 legend colors) + 200-dpi raster pixel-verification + vision confirmation of 9 check-states (NY, TX, CA, AK, VT, IA, IL, OH, PA all confirmed); 50 states classified
capacity_side.known_extremes_check: map prose states range 28.8/100k (DC) to 2.0/100k (VT) — DC classifies 15.2-29 and VT 2-7.4 per the vision read, consistent
capacity_side.pull_status: REAL OBSERVED (from the NRI PDF already on disk from the lane-4/5 pull session)
capacity_side.limitation: BUCKET grain (4 ordinal classes), not exact values — the map publishes classes only; ordinal tests only, no interpolated values

prevalence_side.pull_status: REAL OBSERVED (keyless Socrata; this is the measure the lane-5 pull marked available-that-pass)

outcome_side.source: CDC Mapping-IOV state (Socrata fpsi-y8tj, banked in _lane5_state_raw.json ioV_state)

capacity_arm_only.description: capacity bucket (ordinal 0-3) vs each outcome; Spearman + Mann-Whitney U (top bucket 15.2-29 vs bottom bucket 2-7.4)
capacity_arm_only.verdict: HONEST-NULL: 8/8 cells (2 periods x 4 intents) non-significant, all |rho| < 0.15; suicide runs in the naive-negative direction but weak (rho -0.13/-0.14, p ~0.3); the Sweden-anchored rank-3 within-county effect (-7.6%/10 beds) does NOT appear as a between-state ecological read
capacity_arm_only.confidence: med (bucket grain understates within-bucket variance; the null is on ordinal classes)

prevalence_arm.description: prevalence measures vs the SAME outcomes (the competing arm)
prevalence_arm.verdict: PREVALENCE BEATS CAPACITY on the suicide/fatality margin (rho 0.29-0.51 vs capacity's -0.14), and the two arms are approximately ORTHOGONAL (collinearity rho 0.031-0.034) — capacity and prevalence are NOT the same axis in the state cross-section
prevalence_arm.confidence: med (ecological, direction-class; the 0.51 read is firearm-deaths x poor-MH-days, plausible same-family inflation — flagged)

competing_predictor_headline.question: Which arm explains more outcome variance in the state cross-section: CAPACITY (state-hospital residents/100k buckets) or PREVALENCE (BRFSS MH measures)?
competing_predictor_headline.answer: PREVALENCE, decisively, on the suicide/fatality margin (best cell 0.51 vs capacity's best 0.14); on homicide both arms read ~0.11-0.14 (both near-null)
competing_predictor_headline.implication_for_grid: the v10 pairing-4 verdict 'capacity-side verified, prevalence-side thin' now resolves at the state-ecology grain: the two arms are orthogonal axes (rho ~0.03), and the suicide-geography co-clustering Khan 2026 reports is carried by the PREVALENCE arm, not the capacity arm

honest_nulls: capacity-vs-homicide: null (8/8 cells n.s.) — the within-county Sweden bed effect does not survive as a between-state ecological
exact per-state resident/100k values: NOT capturable from the keyless layer this pass (NRI publishes bucket classes only; Figure 4 is a map) — ordinal tests only
DC/PR and territories: DC carried in the NRI map classification; PR absent from NRI Fig-4 map (excluded, flagged)
verdict: THE COMPETING-PREDICTOR DESIGN RETURNS A SPLIT: capacity arm = 8/8 honest-null (no between-state Penrose on the cross-section); prevalence arm = the suicide/fatality carrier (rho up to 0.51); arms orthogonal (rho ~0.03). First on-disk completion of the v10 pairing-4 design gap. Direction-class only.
